prompt: Output only a single self-contained SVG (600x400 canvas, no external resources, no explanatory text outside the code). Draw a 5x5 grid of equal cells spanning most of the canvas, with cells labeled by row letter (A–E) and column number (1–5) in a readable font. Shade exactly the cells that form a valid solution to this constraint: each row and each column must contain exactly two shaded cells, and no two shaded cells may share an edge (diagonal contact is allowed). Below or beside the grid, list the coordinates of all shaded cells (e.g., "A1, A3, ...") in order, and state the total count. All labels and text must be legible and must not overlap each other, the grid lines, or the shaded cells' content.
